title: Code 3 TCG — next 100 UI improvements
scope: Read-only source audit and design backlog. No implementation, deployment, user-data write or price change.
basis: Reviewed the current local candidate after completion of UI items 1–100. Source-observed friction is verified from code, not a claim of a new live-device test. Proposals are intentionally labeled and need design/behavior review before implementation.
exclusions: Completed improvements 1–100 are not re-listed. Adjacent ideas identify their additional acceptance target.
Current catalog-image, product-image and 3D/tilt work is excluded.
No proposal authorizes automatic merging, deletion, price replacement, private-source scraping or permission bypass.

priorities.P1: Reduce confusion, protect reviewed work, or unblock a common workflow.
priorities.P2: Improve frequent navigation, comparison or editing tasks.
priorities.P3: Useful optional customization after core friction is addressed.
